_comment: Copy to configs/sprint2.json and fill in every null. POBP codes: check the PUMS data dictionary for your vintage. Origin shares: SENAFRONT/SNM Darien irregular-transit counts by nationality (raw counts or shares; they are renormalised to the groups listed). The first origin is the calibration reference.

origin_shares._source: Servicio Nacional de Migracion (Panama), Transito irregular por Darien, Cuadro No. 003, year 2022 (Dec 2022 release). Raw counts, Jan-Sep 2022 sum (total 151,582 entries; Venezuela 71.05%). Renormalised to the groups listed.

maxent._comment: Optional; these are the defaults. strata_edges: education strata as age-band edges (under 5, 5-17, 18+). variants: name -> control variables the sample's education shares are taken within ([] = pooled, [origin] = separate).

ipf._comment: Optional. drop_age_edges: age-band lower edges to remove for IPF (e.g. [5] merges 0-4 into 0-17); global and reported, never per origin. Default [] (strict).

crossover._comment: Optional. origin: thin group (default: smallest in the flow). sizes are capped at its flow count.
